_comment: Hand-labeled ground truth for the static-object gate harness (reports/2026-07-03-referential-grounding-design.md). One entry per fixture frame. 'targets' = ground-truth object bboxes (the Poke Ball table balls) in [x0,y0,x1,y1] px (160x144 frame). Distractor frames have an empty 'targets' list and MUST score 0 phantom candidates. bboxes were derived from the exact red-saliency connected components (area~80, collinear) documented in the design doc's Channel B probe -- verified per-frame via eval/score_static_objects.py's own inspection, not guessed.
